dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (This well-preserved diary bears the scent of the sea-breeze.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...We tied up two spies from the Shogun's army and threw them into the sea. We should all stay sharp. This is no place of peace..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...We should focus on robbing outlanders and their ships. Most outlanders who can enter Inazuma are rich and unwary..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...They're far easier targets than Shogunate ships..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "If the war between the Shogunate and Sangonomiya continues, and we continue to plunder, perhaps the great age of piracy might soon be revived. We shall be like Domeki 500 years ago..."
